tasks.text: In the staff table (인원 현황), what are the alignment and the line spacing of the figure 7,850? Answer `ANSWER: align=<value> line-spacing=<value>`.
What is the first-line indent of the paragraph that begins "ㅇ (노동절 입법)"? Answer `ANSWER: first-line=<pt>`.
What are the line spacing and the font of the paragraph that begins "ㅇ (현장 밀착관리)"? Answer `ANSWER: line-spacing=<value> font=<name>`.

What are the first-line indent, the space before and the line spacing of the paragraph "□ 기본이 지켜지는 일터: 임금체불 청산율 88.3%로 역대 최고…"? Answer `ANSWER: first-line=<pt> space-before=<pt> line-spacing=<value>`.
In the organisation chart (the table with 장관, 차관, 대변인…), what is the line spacing of the cell "대변인"? Answer `ANSWER: line-spacing=<value>`.
Change the fill of the banner "기금형 퇴직연금 활성화…" to light blue.
In the paragraph that begins "ㅇ (현장 밀착관리)", change "1,200명" to "1,300명". Change nothing else: its formatting must stay exactly as it is.
Set the line spacing of the paragraph that begins "ㅇ (임금체불 근절)" to 162%. If it already has that line spacing, change nothing and answer `ANSWER: unchanged`.
Set the space before of the paragraph that begins "ㅇ (근본 대책)" to 12pt. No other paragraph may change.
Create a new style named "표가운데" with 9pt text and apply it to the figures of the staff table (인원 현황).
Change the style 표가운데 so that all of its paragraphs turn navy (#1F3864).
Set the first-line indent of every paragraph that begins with "□" to 10pt.

Create a new style named "강조 문단" that is the default style (바탕글) with dark red text (#C00000), and apply it to the two paragraphs that begin "ㅇ (근본 대책)" and "ㅇ (현장 밀착관리)". Their other formatting stays as it is.
